entities.summary: Brazilian, a notable figure in the history of Uruguay, associated with Artigas, Independence, and the Struggle for Sovereignty (1811–1820). Preceded by Oriental Revolution and Artigas leads Oriental Revolution against Spain. Their legacy influenced Artigas issues radical agrarian reform (Reglamento Provisorio) and Portuguese-Brazilian forces invade — 1816, Artigas exiled 1820.
